item.tib: bstan srung brag btsan dmar po'i tshogs kyi 'phrin las me ri 'khyil ba
item.coloph: ces pa bstan srung brag btsan rgyal po'i tshogs kyi phrin las me ri 'khyil ba zhes bya ba 'di nyid bdag 'dra snyigs ma'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can la rgyal khyung mi yi dbang po btsan rgyal grags pa yab sras nas/ bkra shis lha rdzas dri med dang / dbang dar le rgan dmar po dang / rin chen snying po tsha rog dang / pad ris bkra ba'i zhal bu dang / bka' rgyud 'dzin pa'i gleg thag bcas/ rten 'brel rgya yi dngos po'i mtshon zhing / bstan srung brag btsan 'di dag sngon ma'i dus nas/ mi rabs rgyud du mgon pa'i srung ma khyad par can/ dbra rigs khyung po'i pho lha ru grags pa'i/ de dag gi 'phrin las tshogs 'khor rgyas par/ rab tu gter ram/ snyan rgyud min du blo la thol shar gyi rtsom pa sogs byed dgos kyi bka' byung ba brten/ brag btsan gyi sgrub rgyud bka' gter mtha' dag nas bsdus te/ dus kyi pho nya ces pa sa pho rta yi lo/ hor zla bdun pa'i yar tshes la/ khyung gser sgar chen pho brang mi 'jig rnam rgyal khong du bgyis shing*/ de tshe rnams snang rmi lam du yang / brag btsan dgyes pa dngos grub ster ba sogs kyi rtags mtshan bzang po dang bcas te grub pa/ gang zag dam ldan tshul bzhin sgrub pa dang*/ srung ma gzhung du bstan pa rnams las/ gang yin la 'byams su spel du mi rung ba sa ma ya//
